evals.prompt: We're about to build a new internal platform for tracking lab samples across three sites (intake, testing, reporting). Probably 3-5 services and two small teams. I want to do this properly with DDD before anyone writes code — can you run the whole modelling process on this? Ask me questions where you need to.
evals.expected_output: Resolves ./ddd as the workspace, runs ddd-understand first (creating manifest with scale_target 3-5 deployables, 2 teams), then each step in order with interactive checkpoints, gating every hop with ddd validate, and ends with a coverage summary listing every artifact, open questions and the review order.

evals.prompt: ddd status — where did we get to last week and what's next?
evals.expected_output: Runs ddd validate --status on the existing ddd/ workspace, prints the step table with statuses/open-question counts, names the next step (first pending/stale/draft) and stops without running anything.

evals.prompt: I changed my mind about the bounded contexts in ddd/03-decompose — merged billing into subscriptions. Redo everything downstream of that, no questions, just draft it and tell me what to review.
evals.expected_output: Re-runs ddd-decompose (or accepts the edited artifact), marks strategize..code stale, runs each downstream step sequentially in auto mode with ddd validate gates, and ends with a coverage summary plus the recommended human review order.
